name: @deepseek-ai/zdsh-factory-bundle
description: Factory preinstall artifact bundle: pins the git-URL + commit for every zDSH factory-seeded plugin so `pnpm install` lands each artifact under this package's node_modules closure (B4 case, DESIGN-intake-tech.md §1.1). The governance SeedPreinstaller never moves artifacts; it installs them in place via `install({ source: 'local:<...>/node_modules/<pkg>' })`. Batch 2 current set = webstack-verticals (factory-off pilot) + omnivision (boot-enabled) + webstack-bridge (boot-enabled webstack data-plane link).
